components.label: wire
responsibilities: The collector wire that every native collector shares: requests, replies and source identities.
forbidden_responsibilities: Reading source of any language, and using a collector crate.

components.label: snapshot
responsibilities: The one owner of how a collector reads a snapshot: POSIX paths, contained reads, the symlink rule, the size limit and the digest of each input.
forbidden_responsibilities: Language rules, such as which directory holds installed packages, and parsing source.

requires.rationale: A read input is a wire input with a digest and a role.

components.label: facts
responsibilities: The typed facts of protocol 10: closed kinds, newtype ids and reason codes, defined once.
forbidden_responsibilities: Reading a snapshot, parsing source and storing facts.

components.label: store
responsibilities: Validate facts once and keep them for the rules and the views.
forbidden_responsibilities: Reading source and using a collector crate.

requires.rationale: The store validates and holds the typed facts.

components.label: build
responsibilities: Record the digest of the sources of native/ when a collector builds.
forbidden_responsibilities: Reading source at run time, and using a collector crate.

components.label: typescript
responsibilities: Read TypeScript source and write the collection reply.

requires.rationale: The collector decodes the request and encodes the reply with the shared wire.
Every read of the snapshot goes through the one owner of paths, symlink rules and limits.
The collector will write typed facts once protocol 10 exists.
The build script of the crate calls the shared helper that digests the sources, so one script owns the digest.

rules.rationale: A file that no crate owns escapes every rule below.
A crate uses another crate only where requires says so; absence forbids. This is the crate direction of AD-327.
Crates stay layered: the wire is the base and no collector crate is below another.
Only a collector parses source with Tree-sitter; no library crate does.
Only the TypeScript collector loads the TypeScript grammar.
